```{r setup, include=FALSE}

wd <- "~/Desktop/Research/edge-analysis"
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = wd)

# call in packages
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# set working directory

```

## Biomass Analysis


```{r calculate biomass}

# load data
edge_plot_data <- read_csv("plot_data.csv")
spCoef <- read_csv("biomass_equations.csv")

# calculate biomass and combine dataframes
edge_plot_data <- edge_plot_data %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(spCoef) %>%
  mutate(
    AGB_kg = ifelse(formulaType == 1, b1 * (dbh^b2),
                   ifelse(formulaType == 3, exp(b1 + b2 * log(dbh)), # This is also the genJen formula; we updated genJen table to be formula = 3
                          ifelse(formulaType == 5, (b1 * (dbh^b2)) / 1000,
                                 ifelse(formulaType == 7, exp((b1 + b2 * log(dbh)) / 1000), NA))))
  ) %>%
  mutate(AGB_Mg = round(AGB_kg / 1000, 3))

```



```{r biomass per subplot}

# sum biomass for each subplot
subplot_summary <- edge_plot_data %>%
  group_by(plot_id, subplot) %>%
  summarise(biomass_Mg = sum(AGB_Mg, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# plot bar graphs of biomass per subplot for each plot
ggplot(subplot_summary, aes(x = factor(subplot), y = biomass_Mg, fill = factor(subplot))) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ plot_id) + 
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "YlGn", direction = -1) +
  labs(
    title = "Subplot Biomass Comparison Across Plots",
    x = "Subplot Position (1 = Edge, 3 = Interior)",
    y = "Total Biomass (Mg)",
    fill = "Subplot"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90"))

ggsave("plots/subplot_biomass_bar.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# graph boxplot across all plots 
ggplot(subplot_summary, aes(x = factor(subplot), y = biomass_Mg, fill = factor(subplot))) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Overall Distribution of Biomass Across Subplots",
    x = "Subplot Position (1 = Edge, 3 = Interior)",
    y = "Total Subplot Biomass (Mg)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave("plots/subplot_biomass_boxplot.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```

## Basal Area Analysis

```{r basal area analysis}

# calculate basal area per tree and sum per subplot
subplot_basal_area <- edge_plot_data %>%
  mutate(tree_basal_area_m2 = 0.00007854 * (dbh^2)) %>%
  group_by(plot_id, subplot) %>%
  summarise(basal_area_m2 = sum(tree_basal_area_m2, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

subplot_summary <- subplot_summary %>%
  left_join(subplot_basal_area, by = c("plot_id", "subplot"))

# plot boxplots for basal area
ggplot(subplot_summary, aes(x = factor(subplot), y = basal_area_m2, fill = factor(subplot))) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, notch = TRUE) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Greens") +
  labs(
    title = "Total Basal Area by Subplot",
    x = "Subplot Position (1 = Edge, 3 = Interior)",
    y = "Total Basal Area (m²)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave("plots/subplot_basal_area.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```


## QMD Analysis

```{r QMD analysis}

# calculate QMD per subplot
subplot_qmd <- edge_plot_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(dbh) & dbh > 0) %>%
  group_by(plot_id, subplot) %>%
  summarise(
    QMD_cm = sqrt(mean(dbh^2)),
    tree_count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

subplot_summary <- subplot_summary %>%
  left_join(subplot_qmd, by = c("plot_id", "subplot"))

# plot boxplots of QMD by subplot
ggplot(subplot_qmd, aes(x = factor(subplot), y = QMD_cm, fill = factor(subplot))) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, notch = TRUE) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.5, size = 2, color = "darkslategrey") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Greens") +
  labs(
    title = "QMD by Subplot",
    x = "Subplot Position (1 = Edge, 3 = Interior)",
    y = "QMD (cm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave("plots/subplot_qmd.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```

## Edge Cluster Analysis

```{r edge cluster analysis}

# assign cluster ID to each plot by leading letters of plot ID
plot_clusters <- subplot_summary %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_id = str_sub(plot_id, start = 1, end = -2)
  )

# graph boxplot of biomass per subplot, colorcoded by cluster
ggplot(plot_clusters, aes(x = factor(subplot), y = biomass_Mg)) +
  
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "gray95", color = "gray40") +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = cluster_id), width = 0.2, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "plasma") +
  
  labs(
    title = "Subplot Biomass Distribution Across Locations",
    x = "Subplot Position (1 = Edge, 3 = Interior)",
    y = "Total Biomass (Mg)",
    color = "Edge Location"
    
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("plots/subplot_cluster_boxplot.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```

```{r edge cluster averages}

library(stringr)

# get average biomass per subplot for each cluster
subplot_clusters <- plot_clusters %>%
  group_by(cluster_id, subplot) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_biomass_Mg = mean(biomass_Mg),
    plot_count = n_distinct(plot_id), # Keeps track of how many plots are in each cluster
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# plot average subplot biomass for each cluster as bar graph
ggplot(subplot_clusters, aes(x = cluster_id, y = avg_biomass_Mg, fill = factor(subplot))) +
  
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", alpha = 0.85, width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "YlGnBu") +
  
  labs(
    title = "Average Subplot Biomass Across Edge Locations",
    x = "Edge Location",
    y = "Average Biomass per Subplot (Mg)",
    fill = "Subplot"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))

ggsave("plots/subplot_cluster_avg_bar.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```
```{r aspect comparison}

# load plot metadata
plot_metadata <- read_csv("plot_metadata.csv")

# merge aspect data with subplot biomass data
biomass_by_aspect <- subplot_summary %>%
  left_join(plot_metadata, by = "plot_id") %>%
  mutate(
    aspect_group = case_when(
      aspect == "N"  ~ "North",
      aspect %in% c("S", "SW") ~ "South",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# plot boxplots of biomass per subplot by aspect
ggplot(biomass_by_aspect, aes(x = factor(subplot), y = biomass_Mg, fill = aspect_group)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(0.8), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(group = aspect_group), position = position_dodge(0.8), alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("North" = "skyblue", "South" = "coral")) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Biomass Distribution Across Subplots by Aspect",
    x = "Subplot Position (1 = Edge, 3 = Interior)",
    y = "Total Biomass (Mg)",
    fill = "Aspect"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("plots/subplot_aspect_boxplot.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```



## ForestGeo Comparison

```{r load and clean forestGEO data}

# download forestGEO data
stemsHFarchives2014 <- read.csv("https://harvardforest.fas.harvard.edu/data/p25/hf253/hf253-05-stems-2014.csv") 
stemsHFarchives2019 <- read.csv("https://harvardforest.fas.harvard.edu/data/p25/hf253/hf253-06-stems-2019.csv") 

# get GESP codes for each species name
spcw <- read.csv("https://harvardforest.fas.harvard.edu/data/p25/hf253/hf253-02-species-codes.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(sp,genus,species) %>% 
  mutate(gesp= toupper(
    paste0(
      substr(genus,1,2),
      substr(species,1,2)
    )
  ))

# load species crosswalk file
spCoef <- read_csv("equations.csv")


# clean and match forestGEO data

# select needed columns
cols <- c("stem.tag","sp","quadrat","census.id","dbh","status","codes")

# fill in missing census.id for 2019 data
stems14 <- stemsHFarchives2014 %>% 
  select(all_of(cols))
stems19 <- stemsHFarchives2019 %>% 
  select(all_of(cols)) %>% 
  # fill in NA census.id with 2
  replace_na(list(census.id=2))

# combine datasets and join on latin name column
forestgeo_stems <- stems14 %>% 
  bind_rows(stems19) %>%
  left_join(spcw)

# fill in missing quadrat data
forestgeo_stems <- forestgeo_stems %>% 
  group_by(stem.tag) %>% 
  #sort stem.tag by census.id so that the first instance of the group should have a quadrat id
  arrange(stem.tag,census.id) %>% 
  #fill in the missing quadrat data for each stem.tag group
  mutate(quadrat=coalesce(quadrat,first(quadrat)),
         #how many surveys where the stem was measured
         n=length(stem.tag)) 

# get biomass by joining with spCoef
forestgeo_stems <- forestgeo_stems %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(spCoef) %>% 
  mutate(AGBkg=ifelse(formulaType==1,b1*(dbh^b2),
                      ifelse(formulaType==3,exp(b1+b2*log(dbh)),  #this is also the genJen formula #we updated genJen table to be formula =3
                             ifelse(formulaType==5,  (b1*(dbh^b2))/1000   ,
                                    ifelse(formulaType==7,exp((b1 + b2*log(dbh))/1000)     , NA )))))  %>% 
  mutate(AGBMg=round(AGBkg/1000,3)) 

```

```{r plot biomass density histograms}

# calculate biomass density for each edge plot
plot_summary <- edge_plot_data %>%
  group_by(plot_id) %>% 
  summarise(biomass_Mg = sum(AGB_Mg, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(
    biomass_per_ha = biomass_Mg * (10000 / 300)
  )

# plot histogram of biomass density per edge plot
ggplot(plot_summary, aes(x = biomass_per_ha)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue2", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
  xlim(0, 600) + 
  labs(
    title = "Total Biomass Density Per Edge Plot",
    x = "Biomass per Hectare (Mg/ha)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)


ggsave("plots/biomass_density_plots.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# calculate biomass density for each ForestGEO quadrat in 2019
quadrat_summary <- forestgeo_stems %>%
  filter(census.id == 2) %>% # only count 2019 entries
  filter(dbh >= 10) %>% # only count trees over 10 cm DBH
  group_by(quadrat) %>% 
  summarise(biomass_Mg = sum(AGBMg, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(
    biomass_per_ha = biomass_Mg * (10000 / 400),
  )

# plot histogram of biomass per ForestGEO quadrat
ggplot(quadrat_summary, aes(x = biomass_per_ha)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue2", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
  xlim(0, 600) + # ignore 2 entries above 600 Mg/ha
  labs(
    title = "Total Biomass Density Per ForestGEO Quadrat in 2019",
    x = "Biomass per Hectare (Mg/ha)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

ggsave("plots/biomass_density_quadrats.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

  
```

```{r forestGEO boxplot comparisons}

# get biomass density and label locations for subplot data
subplot_summary <- edge_plot_data %>%
  group_by(plot_id, subplot) %>%
  summarise(biomass_Mg = sum(AGB_Mg, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(
    biomass_per_ha = biomass_Mg * (10000 / 100), # Multiplier is now 100 for a 100m² subplot
    position = case_when(
      subplot == 1 ~ "1 (Edge)",
      subplot == 2 ~ "2 (Transition)",
      subplot == 3 ~ "3 (Interior)"
    )
  )

# label location for quadrat data
quadrat_summary <- quadrat_summary %>%
  mutate(position = "4 (Deep Interior)")

# bind all edge subplot and ForestGEO quadrat data
edge_forestgeo_bind <- bind_rows(subplot_summary, quadrat_summary)

# plot boxplot for all subplot and interior locations
ggplot(edge_forestgeo_bind, aes(x = position, y = biomass_per_ha, fill = position)) +

  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, color = "gray30") +
  geom_jitter(data = filter(edge_forestgeo_bind, position != "4 (Deep Interior)"), 
              width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "YlGn") +
  ylim(0, 600) + 
  
  labs(
    title = "Biomass Density from Edge to Deep Interior",
    x = "Location",
    y = "Biomass Density (Mg/ha)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggsave("plots/subplots_quadrats_boxplot.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)



# label plot and quadrat AGB density data
plots_AGB_density <- plot_summary %>%
  mutate(
      location = "Edge Plots"
    ) %>%
  select(location, biomass_per_ha)
    
quadrats_AGB_density <- quadrat_summary %>%
  mutate(
      location = "ForestGEO Quadrats"
    ) %>%
  select(location, biomass_per_ha)

# combine edge plot and quadrat AGB density data
AGB_density_bind <- bind_rows(plots_AGB_density, quadrats_AGB_density)  

# plot 2 boxes comparing plot vs. quadrat biomass density
ggplot(AGB_density_bind, aes(x = location, y = biomass_per_ha, fill = location)) +

  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, color = "gray30", width = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(data = filter(AGB_density_bind, location == "Edge Plots"), 
              width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6, size = 2, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Edge Plots" = "cornsilk", "ForestGEO Quadrats" = "chartreuse4")) +
  ylim(0, 600) + 
  
  labs(
    title = "Edge vs. Interior Biomass Density",
    x = "Location",
    y = "Biomass Density (Mg/ha)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  )

ggsave("plots/plots_quadrats_boxplot.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```
